pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit concurrent order execution within the same 60-second window; require minimum +$5.00 unrealized profit buffer on initial position before authorizing any secondary scale-in.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Reject any execution request where calculated distance to hard SL exceeds $5.00 per 0.01 lot or where high-impact economic news releases fall within +/- 15 minutes.
profit_harvest_threshold: Lock breakeven at +$4.00 unrealized profit; harvest 50% lot size at +$10.00 and trailing-stop the remainder targeting $20.00+ runs.
